mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bmi (mno, childId, birthDate, gender, ageMonth, bmiValue, height, weight, recordDate) VALUES (#{mno}, #{childId}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{ageMonth}, #{bmiValue}, #{height}, #{weight}, CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), '+00:00', '+09:00'))
mapper.select: SELECT childId FROM child WHERE mno = #{mno} ORDER BY childId ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.bmiNo, b.mno, b.childId, b.height, b.weight, b.bmiValue, b.ageMonth, b.recordDate, c.birth AS birthDate, c.gender FROM bmi b JOIN child c ON b.childId = c.childId WHERE b.mno = #{mno} AND b.childId = #{childId} ORDER BY b.recordDate ASC
SELECT * FROM bmi WHERE mno = #{mno} AND childId = #{childId} AND recordDate BETWEEN CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') ORDER BY recordDate DESC
SELECT b.bmiNo, b.mno, b.childId, b.height, b.weight, b.bmiValue, b.ageMonth, b.recordDate, c.birth AS birthDate, c.gender FROM bmi b JOIN child c ON b.childId = c.childId WHERE b.bmiNo = #{bmiNo}
